Locally served, pinned browser distributions. No CDN or runtime package installation is required.

- GSAP 3.15.0 and ScrollTrigger: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
- anime.js 4.5.0: https://animejs.com/documentation/

The original license files and distribution copyright headers are retained. GSAP owns entrances and scroll reveals; anime.js owns short interaction feedback. `calm.js` manages motion preferences and cleanup for both engines.
